INVESTIGATION OF BREAST CANCER
Investigation
- FNAC/core needle biopsy/incisional or excision biopsy: For
histopathological and immunohistochemical analyses
- Chest x-ray, abdominal USS, bone scan, with or withoutCT
chest/abdomen: For Staging
- Others: FBC, LFT, Electrolyte, Urea and Creatinine
